items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: [(note)] *Red Garland, Paul Chambers and Philly Joe Jones, with John Coltrane, were members of the Miles Davis quintet, 1955-1956.

ctx.x: This band with Dizzy and ya'll were in Pittsburgh.
Yeah. So everynight, uhm, I would I would look out in the audience and it would be Colrane , Miles, everybody standing up there looking at us, listening at us play.
